FAST

Sept 23 : The new College Swimming League will launch its inaugural season on Thursday outside Chicago, seeking to give one of U.S. college sport's most successful but least visible disciplines a more prominent stage. The league, built in less than a year, brings together 12 programs from the SEC, ACC and Big Ten, three of the leading regional conferences in U.S. college sport, for a fall series of team competitions that will be streamed on ESPN platforms in the United States and shown internationally on DAZN. The opening match at FMC Natatorium in Westmont, Illinois, will feature Indiana, Louisville, Michigan and Ohio State. The eight-event season concludes with a championship in Indianapolis on Nov. 6. College Swimming League CEO Rob Kent said the venture was a calculated gamble, drawing on lessons from the International Swimming League (ISL) while seeking to tap into the established fan bases of major universities.

"There's only really two ways to do it," Kent told Reuters. "You either ease your way into it or you swing for the fences. And guess which side we took." LOOKING TO MAKE A SPLASH  The competition will use a combined men's and women's team format, with four schools competing across 30 events in matches designed to last around two and a half hours. It will include spectator-friendly formats such as Skins, a multi-round elimination race, and a "jackpot" scoring rule that rewards dominant victories. Organizers hope the league can create a more compelling product for broadcasters and fans during a part of the college swimming calendar that has traditionally received limited attention. "We built it so that everybody here will go crazy, which looks really good on broadcast," Kent said, adding that the league was designed primarily with the television audience in mind. The field includes swimmers from more than 35 countries, including Virginia's Italian backstroke specialist Sara Curtis, who set the women's 50 metres backstroke world record in August. Tennessee's Jillian Crooks of the Cayman Islands and Michigan's Stephanie Balduccini of Brazil, both two-time Olympians, are also scheduled to compete. The league, which received funding from ISL founder and Ukrainian businessman Konstantin Grigorishin, will cover nearly $1 million in team travel costs and offer a $100,000 prize purse, with $25,000 going to each of the four schools that reach the championship. The money will go to athletic programs rather than directly to swimmers. Kent said direct athlete compensation was an ambition for the future, but that the first priority was establishing a viable commercial platform for swimmers whose sport has lagged football and basketball in exposure and revenue. "Student athletes that generate revenue should benefit," Kent said. "Swimming doesn't. So why don't we build something for them to do that? And here we are." COO and co-founder Kyle Sockwell said the league could increase athletes' visibility and help create opportunities for name, image and likeness (NIL) deals. "Your NIL just went from, for most of these swimmers, literally zero, to you might be able to get a sponsor because you're on a CSL team," Sockwell said. The top three teams will qualify automatically for the championship, while teams ranked fourth through seventh will compete for the final berth in a Nov. 5 Wild Card meet in Indianapolis.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Orioles complete DH sweep of Blue Jays, extend slim playoff hopes
item.description: Christian Encarnacion-Strand homered and drove in three runs and Trey Gibson took a shutout into the seventh inning as the Baltimore Orioles completed a doubleheader sweep of the visiting Toronto Blue Jays, winning 4-2 on Wednesday night to stay in playoff contention.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Christian Encarnacion-Strand homered and drove in three runs and Trey Gibson took a shutout into the seventh inning as the Baltimore Orioles completed a doubleheader sweep of the visiting Toronto Blue Jays, winning 4-2 on Wednesday night to stay in playoff contention. Baltimore (78-81) must win its remaining three games and have the White Sox (81-77) lose their remaining four in order to have a chance for an American League wild-card spot. Chicago fell 5-4 at Kansas City later Wednesday night. The Orioles, playing their final home games, earlier eliminated Toronto from wild card contention by winning 4-2 in the afternoon portion of the day-night twin bill. Davis Schneider hit a two-run ninth-inning homer off Felix Bautista in the nightcap for the Blue Jays (77-82). Nathan Lukes had two hits. Gibson (2-3), a rookie who hadn't pitched in the major leagues since June 30, gave up three hits and two walks while striking out seven in 6 2/3 innings. A two-out error by second baseman Jeremiah Jackson extended Toronto's seventh before Gibson walked Schneider, who was the last batter he faced. Reliever Yennier Cano entered and walked Charles McAdoo to load the bases before striking out Myles Straw. Josh Walker and Bautista each worked an inning to close out the six-hitter. Toronto starter CJ Van Eyk (0-2), also a rookie, made his first appearance in September and first big-league start. He allowed four runs on four hits in five innings with no walks and two strikeouts. The Orioles opened the scoring for the second time in the day, this time posting three first-inning runs. Encarnacion-Strand drove in two runs with a single to left, and Colton Cowser doubled in the next run. Encarnacion-Strand hit his 11th home run of the season leading off the fourth inning. The Orioles finished 39-42 in home games under first-year manager Craig Albernaz. Both teams are off Thursday before beginning their respective three-game series to end the regular season. The Orioles will visit the New York Yankees, while the Blue Jays will return home to meet the Cincinnati Reds. --Field Level Media

item.title: US FDA advisers endorse Grail cancer test's benefits in key vote
item.description: A panel of outside experts advising the US FDA said on Wednesday the benefits of Grail's blood-based cancer detection test outweigh its risks, paving the way for a potential landmark approval in cancer screening.
item.dc:creator: Padmanabhan Ananthan, Kamal Choudhury
item.content:encoded: A panel of outside experts advising the US FDA said on Wednesday the benefits of Grail's (GRAL.O) blood-based cancer detection test outweigh its risks, paving the way for a potential landmark approval in cancer screening. In a 7-2 vote with one abstention, the expert panel concluded that the test Galleri's ability to catch difficult-to-detect cancers justified its use in adults aged 50 and older. While the committee unanimously endorsed the test's safety, members split 6-4 on whether the evidence demonstrated its effectiveness. "This increases our confidence even more on FDA approval — almost derisked," Subbu Nambi, analyst at Guggenheim, said. "There is some debate about label, but we ultimately think FDA will approve for a wide range of cancers." The US Food and Drug Administration is not bound by its panel's votes but weighs them heavily when making final decisions. A final decision on whether Galleri can be sold nationwide is expected in the coming months. "By far, I think this is a paradigm shift," Dr. Marc Matrana, a medical oncologist at Ochsner MD Anderson Cancer Center and principal investigator on one of Grail's trials, had told Reuters before the meeting, citing strong patient interest. Galleri screens for multiple cancers from a single blood draw. In a US study, it detected 35% of cancers within 12 months and achieved a specificity of 99.85%. Results from a separate study in Britain were broadly consistent, reinforcing the test's low false-positive rate and cancer-detection capabilities. The committee also emphasized that doctors must clearly explain test limitations to patients so they do not skip proven screenings such as mammograms and colonoscopies, urging that Galleri must be an "addition, not substitution" to standard care. Both Grail's Galleri and Abbott's (ABT.N) Cancerguard are available to patients under Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments regulations, but neither of them is FDA-approved.

FAST

Sept 24 : Tesla’s FSD automated-driving system frequently exceeded speed limits and attempted to overtake cyclists on streets where it's prohibited, a road-safety advocacy group said, citing tests it conducted in Belgium. The Belgian group Johanna.be - which advocates for pedestrian and cyclist safety - tested Tesla’s system over three days in July, covering about 400 km (249 miles). It found that FSD often exceeded speed limits in 20 km/h and 30 km/h zones, and incorrectly displayed higher speed limits to drivers, potentially misleading them about how fast the vehicle should travel. Tesla’s FSD driver-assistance feature can perform most driving tasks but requires drivers to pay strict attention. Dutch regulator RDW approved the system in April, with Belgium and a handful of other countries following suit. An EU-wide vote could happen on October 6. Several EU countries, including Sweden, have expressed concerns about FSD exceeding speed limits, while countries that approved it say drivers remain responsible for complying with traffic laws.

Tesla and RDW did not respond to Reuters requests for comment.  Tesla released a study earlier this month saying that FSD-enabled Teslas do not speed excessively and drive at speeds matching surrounding traffic. Xavier Lesenne, spokesperson for the Flemish government’s transportation ministry, which approved FSD in Belgium earlier this year, said it is "a learning system that continuously processes new and additional information" and adapts over time. Lesenne said the driver "remains 100 per cent responsible" and must be ready to intervene "should the system make an error or fail to correctly apply a traffic rule." Lesenne said data from Tesla shows the technology "holds significant potential for accident prevention today." Johanna.be found that FSD exceeded the limit in the majority of the tested 30 km/h road segments around Brussels, averaging 44 km/h. Even though the vehicle's screen showed the system recognised 30 km/h speed-limit signs on the roadside, it often displayed an incorrect speed limit of 50 km/h. "It is akin to a passenger constantly reassuring the driver that the speed limit is 50 km/h in nearly every 30-zone through which they pass," the report said. Videos collected by the group show the FSD-enabled Tesla attempting to overtake cyclists on streets where doing so is not allowed. The European Transport Safety Council has previously raised concerns about whether FSD can comply with differing road rules across Europe. The Johanna.be report also noted positive aspects of the system, saying it "behaved cautiously and courteously around pedestrians and cyclists, often yielding proactively."  But those benefits "do not offset the documented failures to comply with speed limits and cycle-street regulations." The NGO said it sent the report to the Flemish ministry and RDW, urging both to reassess the approvals.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Report: Giants OLB Brian Burns (ankle) out Sunday, but likely no surgery
item.description: New York Giants edge rusher Brian Burns likely will avoid surgery on his injured left ankle, but he is expected to miss Sunday's home game against the Tennessee Titans, ESPN reported.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New York Giants edge rusher Brian Burns likely will avoid surgery on his injured left ankle, but he is expected to miss Sunday's home game against the Tennessee Titans, ESPN reported. Giants coach John Harbaugh told reporters Wednesday that Burns is day-to-day. The Giants' initial injury report for the week said Burns did not participate in practice, but contained no injury designation. The ace pass rusher left Monday's 28-6 road loss to the Los Angeles Rams upon suffering the injury. He told reporters after the game that he suffered a low ankle sprain. "It eases my mind to know that it ain't nothing serious," Burns said. Burns, 28, registered two tackles and a quarterback hit against Los Angeles. The eight-year veteran has no sacks in the team's first two games after recording a career-high 16.5 last season. This is Burns' third season with the Giants after being acquired in a trade with the Carolina Panthers in March 2024. The Giants signed him to a five-year, $141 million contract soon after the trade. --Field Level Media

item.title: North Korea conducted test of upgraded rocket launcher system, KCNA says
item.description: North Korea conducted a test firing of an upgraded 240mm guided multiple rocket launcher system on Tuesday, state news agency KCNA reported on Thursday, saying the weapon would bolster firepower along the country's southern border.
item.dc:creator: Brenda Goh, Kyu-Seok Shim
item.content:encoded: North Korea conducted a test firing of an upgraded 240mm guided multiple rocket launcher system on Tuesday, state news agency KCNA reported on Thursday, saying the weapon would bolster firepower along the country's southern border. The test demonstrated the accuracy and superiority of the range-extended rockets, which use an autonomous precision guidance system, KCNA said. The rockets are able to strike targets 100 km (62 miles) away in a trajectory flight mode and 115 km away in a combined glide mode, it added. The development of such rockets assures North Korea of a significant change in the firepower readiness along the southern border, the news agency said, effectively referring to the one it shares with South Korea. Pak Jong-chon, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission, who oversaw the test, stressed the need to concentrate the deadliest and most destructive attack forces on the southern border, KCNA said. South Korea's Defence Ministry did not immediately respond to an emailed Reuters request for comment. Pyongyang has been steadily upgrading its tactical and conventional arsenal that it intends to deploy near the border with South Korea. Lim Eul-chul, a professor at Kyungnam University's Institute for Far Eastern Studies in Seoul, said the use of a precision guidance system suggested that North Korea could strike key facilities in the Seoul metropolitan area with a margin of error of just a few metres. This equates to a potential threat to South Korea's heavily populated capital area regardless of the military response and could be intended to induce fear in South Korea, Lim said. In June, North Korean leader Kim Jong Un [USN:L1N42X18G TEXT:"oversaw tests"] of key weapons, including an upgraded rocket launcher and tactical missiles, that the country said would also be used to defend its southern border. Separately, Foreign Minister Choe Son Hui said in a statement issued on Thursday that North Korea's nuclear weapons status [USN:P8N3ZR0H4 TEXT:"was irreversible"] and that the country would only become more resolute after the United States, South Korea and Japan this week reaffirmed their commitment to the complete denuclearisation of North Korea at a trilateral meeting.

item.title: US pledges $267 million more to fight Ebola in central Africa
item.description: The US State Department on Wednesday pledged an additional $267 million toward fighting the Ebola outbreak in central Africa, as health authorities battle to get the deadly virus under control.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US State Department on Wednesday pledged an additional $267 million toward fighting the Ebola outbreak in central Africa, as health authorities battle to get the deadly virus under control. Senior State Department officials announced the funding on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, hoping for pledges of new funds from other countries to meet a target of $2 billion to fight the disease, mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The outbreak was detected in May and is already the [USN:L6N44E0K6 TEXT:"second most lethal"] on record, behind one in West Africa from 2014 to 2016. On Wednesday, Congolese Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka described the outbreak as a "major test" for the country. "For the DRC, fighting this epidemic is an absolute priority. After having contained 16 previous outbreaks, the DRC is mobilizing recognized scientific and operational expertise. And thanks to national mobilization and the support of our partners, the response has recently begun producing tangible results," she told the United Nations General Assembly. The US pledge on Wednesday brings the Trump administration's commitment to tackling the outbreak to $886 million, including $107 million from the Department of Health and Human Services in addition to State Department funding. The assistance would help countries contain the outbreak at its source, one of the officials said, such as for building treatment facilities, providing diagnostics and medical countermeasures for health workers in the field.

item.title: 賃金に大きな上昇圧力見られず、インフレ高進も＝ＥＣＢレーン専務理事
item.description: [ローザンヌ（スイス） ２３日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のチーフエコノミストであるフィリップ・レーン専務...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
賃金に大きな上昇圧力見られず、インフレ高進も＝ＥＣＢレーン専務理事 6:18 配信

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のチーフエコノミスト、フィリップ・レーン専務理事。英ロンドンで６月撮影。REUTERS/Chris J. Ratcliffe

[ローザンヌ（スイス）　２３日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のチーフエコノミストであるフィリップ・レーン専務理事は、今年のエネルギー価格高騰によるインフレ高進を受けても、賃金への大きな上昇圧力は見られていないとし、急速な物価上昇が定着する恐れがあるとの懸念を打ち消した。

レーン氏はスイスの大学での講演で、「エネルギーショックに対する大きな反応は見られない」とした上で、「人々は生活費が予想以上に上昇していることを認識している一方で、多くの企業が『中国に競争で負けている。あまりに高い賃上げを求められるなら、いつでも人工知能（ＡＩ）を導入できる』と考えている」状況が背景にあるとの見方を示した。

８月のユーロ圏消費者物価指数（ＨＩＣＰ）速報値は、エネルギーコストの上昇を背景に再び３％を超えた。一部のエコノミストは、中東情勢の緊迫化を背景に燃料・ガス価格がここ数週間で急騰していることから、年末までに４％に達するとみている。エネルギー価格の急騰を受け、市場はＥＣＢが６月と９月の利上げに加え、さらに３回から４回の追加利上げに踏み切るとの見方を織り込んでいる。

ただ、市場データから上乗せ金利（リスクプレミアム）を除けば、政策金利のピークは来年に３％をやや上回る水準に達し、同年末までに低下する見通しで、実際には追加利上げ２回分しか織り込まれていないとレーン氏は指摘。一方、エネルギー価格は来年半ばまでＥＣＢの「不利なシナリオ」に沿って推移し、その後にようやく基準シナリオの水準に戻ると見込まれており、これがリスク要因になっていると認めた。

レーン氏はまた、天然ガスの在庫不足もリスクだと指摘。エネルギー企業が夏場にガスの備蓄を先送りしたため、備蓄水準は７０％にとどまり、過去の平均を１６％ポイント下回っている。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＥＣＢ「予防的」追加利上げへ、米イラン紛争長期化で アングル：ＥＣＢ、金利据え置きへ　原油価格が再び焦点 アングル：ＡＩの経済金融への影響、ＥＣＢフォーラムで希望と懸念が交錯 アングル：金融市場はＥＣＢのタカ派化見込む、イラン戦による油価高騰で コラム：求むＥＣＢ総裁、危機に強い革新者 最終更新: 9/24(木) 6:18 ロイター

item.title: ハセット氏、FRB追加利上げ疑問視－トランプ氏指名外の当局者批判
item.description:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国家経済会議（NEC）のハセット委員長は23日、インフレが落ち着いているにもかかわらず金融引き締めを進めようとしているとして、トランプ大統領が指名していない米金融当局者を批判した。
ハセット氏はジョージタウン大学でのイベントで、最近のコアインフレ率が年率2%となるなかで「なぜ利上げするのか」と述べた。
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国家経済会議（NEC）のハセット委員長は23日、インフレが落ち着いているにもかかわらず金融引き締めを進めようとしているとして、トランプ大統領が指名していない米金融当局者を批判した。

ハセット氏はジョージタウン大学でのイベントで、最近のコアインフレ率が年率2%となるなかで「なぜ利上げするのか」と述べた。 米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）のウォーシュ議長については「異例なほど党派性の強いFRBを運営している」と語った。

ハセット氏は、FRB議長や副議長は通常、任期満了時にFRBを去るが、その慣例が守られていないと指摘。現FRB理事のジェローム・パウエル氏とマイケル・バー氏を例に挙げた。

パウエル氏は今年、議長としての任期満了後も理事としてとどまった。パウエル氏によると、金融政策を巡るFRBの独立性についてトランプ政権と対立する中での判断だった。バー氏も、昨年の副議長（銀行監督担当）退任後も理事会にとどまっている。

ウォーシュ氏、パウエル氏、バー氏を含む米連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）で投票権を持つ全メンバーが先週の政策金利の引き上げに賛成した。ハセット氏は経済指標に対する自身の見方を踏まえ、「なぜそうしたのか懸念している」と述べた。

ハセット氏は「市場も懸念している。トランプ氏が指名していない多くの当局者がここ数日に講演し、さらに利上げが必要だと述べている」と指摘した。

これは「FRBの独立性を回復するには、なお多くの課題がある」ことを示していると主張。独立性の回復はウォーシュ氏にとって「優先順位が高い」とも述べた。

バー氏は23日、インフレ率をFRBの目標である2%に戻すには、さらなる利上げが必要になる可能性が高いとの見方を示した。ボストン連銀のコリンズ総裁は先週の利上げ決定を支持したと説明。セントルイス連銀のムサレム総裁は、物価上昇を抑えるため追加利上げが必要になる可能性があると述べた。

ORLANDO, Florida, Sept 23 : US bond yields soared on Wednesday, in many cases to the highest since 2007, and expectations of an interest rate hike next month surged, after figures showed that US business activity is expanding at its fastest pace in more than five years. The sharp rise in market borrowing costs, and higher oil prices, pushed stocks into the red. In my column today, I look at the risk to ordinary investors posed by the record concentration of US stock market value in AI and 'tech-adjacent' companies. Passively managed index tracker funds are essentially tech funds now. Today's Key Reads

• Pezeshkian says Iran won't surrender, after Trump's annihilation threat • US business activity at more than five-year high; inflation pressures building • There's a reason Trump is the only one talking about 1 per cent interest rates • Darkest before dawn? Funds mull return to bonds: Mike Dolan • Trump's diesel export dilemma — Good politics, bad economics: Bousso • Today's Key Market Moves STOCKS: Wall Street down: Dow -0.7 per cent, S&P 500 -0.8 per cent, Nasdaq -1.1 per cent. Europe -0.4 per cent.SECTORS/SHARES: Every sector on the S&P 500 falls except energy, which rises 1 per cent. Comms services, utilities -2 per cent. Expedia, Airbnb -8 per cent. Booking Holdings, McDonald's -5 per cent. Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike Holdings +5 per cent.FX: Dollar leaps 0.5 per cent to highest in nearly 2 months. Dollar/yen above 158.00.BONDS: French 10y 4.60 per cent, US 10y 5.10 per cent, highest since 2007-08. Extremely weak US 5y auction - lowest demand since 2018.COMMODITIES/METALS: Oil snaps 5-day losing streak, Brent +4 per cent, WTI +2 per cent. US diesel futures -2 per cent to 2-week low. Gold -1.5 per cent. Today's Talking Points: 'Risk free' 5 per cent The yield on every US Treasury note or bond, with the exception of the two-year note, traded above 5 per cent on Wednesday, with the five-year yield crossing that threshold for the first time since 2007. The two-year yield is only 5 basis points away, so it's conceivable that the whole US Treasury yield curve could be above 5 per cent later this week. That would also be a first since 2007. It's only a number, but it could have psychological significance. It could tempt all kinds of investors to diversify away from expensive stocks and lock in attractive returns on 'risk-free' assets (the real yield on 10-year TIPS is 2.78 per cent, the highest since 2008). On the other hand, today's 5-year auction was awful. These yields are a reminder that we are in a brave new world, where the cost of capital is high and seemingly heading higher. Debt servicing — for consumers, businesses and the Treasury — is getting more expensive. Buckle up. Here Xi comes Chinese President Xi Jinping arrives in Washington for his summit on Thursday with US President Donald Trump. The visit will be marked with pomp, pageantry and platitudes, but will it yield much else? Investors' expectations are low, but Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent indicated on Wednesday that there may be some progress on trade. Bessent said the US is open to extending the trade truce that expires on November 10 or considering a possibly larger trade deal, without giving details, other than it was the Chinese delegation's proposal. If Trump and Xi reach agreement on trade, there's unlikely to be much cooperation on AI. Mutual trust is low, and neither side wants to slow down development. Diesel down US diesel futures slid 2 per cent on Wednesday to a two-week low, reacting to comments from Trump the day before that he backs a ban on US diesel exports as a way to cool record high prices at the pump. Politico also reported that the administration was preparing a 90-day ban, which a White House official denied. Confused? Trump will no doubt be desperate to get diesel prices down, especially ahead of the US midterm elections in November. But while an export ban might play well politically, it may not have the desired effect, as it could push US refineries to cut the amount of crude they process, which would reduce the amount of gasoline and other products produced, which could raise prices. What could move markets tomorrow? • Chinese President Xi Jinping visits US President Donald Trump in Washington • Japan PMIs (September, flash estimate) • Germany Ifo business index (September) • US Treasury sells $44 billion of 7-year notes at auction • US Federal Reserve officials scheduled to speak include New York Fed President John Williams, Richmond Fed President Thomas Barkin, Philadelphia Fed President Anna Paulson, and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack Want to receive Trading Day in your inbox every weekday morning? item.title: US FDA expected to unveil steps to accelerate vape, nicotine pouch approvals, WSJ reports
item.description: The US Food and Drug Administration is expected to unveil measures in the coming days that would speed up approvals for vaping products and nicotine pouches, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Food and Drug Administration is expected to unveil measures in the coming days that would speed up approvals for vaping products and nicotine pouches, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter. The FDA is expected to announce it will revisit a 2021 rule outlining requirements for new tobacco applications, according to the report. The agency could also simplify requirements for scientific studies and speed up review times to add flexibility for more products to get authorized, the report said. Reuters could not immediately verify the report. The FDA did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Tobacco companies have long urged US President Donald Trump and other key officials for changes including a faster, clearer FDA authorization process. Last month, the FDA [USN:L6N44P0ZU TEXT:"allowed"] the marketing of three new 'JUUL2' e-cigarette products, adding to a series of approvals for nicotine products that the agency says may offer a better alternative to traditional cigarettes. "The Trump administration is committed to keeping nicotine out of the hands of kids, getting counterfeit vaping products off the streets and providing safer alternatives for adults who want to quit smoking cigarettes," an HHS spokesperson said. During Trump's first term, his administration had moved to pull flavored e-cigarettes from retail shelves as part of a broader effort to curb youth vaping, warning that sweet flavors had enticed millions of children to become addicted to nicotine.

item.title: Australia says OpenAI agent hacked into government website
item.description: Australia said on Wednesday an OpenAI agent breached a government health data portal in June, gaining unauthorised access to files, in what could be the first known instance of an AI agent hacking a government website.
item.dc:creator: Renju Jose, Chris Thomas
item.content:encoded: Australia said on Wednesday an OpenAI agent breached a government health data portal in June, gaining unauthorised access to files, in what could be the first known instance of an AI agent hacking a government website. The breach is one of the highest-profile incidents of AI agents accessing external systems outside the United States, coming on top of several recent breaches globally by [USN:L6N4580VP TEXT:"rogue AIagents"] that have alarmed governments and companies. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said the OpenAI agent gained unauthorised access to the medical statistics portal of a government agency responsible for non-sensitive health data and statistics, including public medical spending. "Evidence currently available is there is no broader compromise to the ... network. Nonetheless, this situation is obviously unacceptable," Albanese said during a media briefing in New York, where he is attending the UN General Assembly. Investigations continue and Australia had voiced its "extreme concern about this incident" to OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Albanese said, adding that he was deeply disappointed by the company's delay in notifying the government. "It took until September 10 before there was any notification at all," Albanese said, adding that the investigation would also examine why government systems had failed to detect the breach in the first place. He also warned that three other government websites "may be impacted" by the OpenAI agent's activity. "The question is, when it was trying to harvest data, did it go into these other sites? So we're not confirming that that occurred," he said. The incident comes after OpenAI and Anthropic, in separate submissions to a parliamentary inquiry this month, urged Australia to reconsider a ban on use of the country's creative content to train their models. 'AI MODELS ATTEMPTED TO LOOK UP ANSWERS' "Our review found no evidence of patient records being accessed. The information accessed included aggregate health statistics and internal file names," OpenAI said in a statement. It added that it "identified activity involving several Australian government websites and services as our models attempted to look up answers ... our models took actions we did not intend." The Australian breach is the latest of several recent incidents in which OpenAI has disclosed hacks or unauthorised activity involving its AI agents well after they occurred. In some cases this was because the activity was only detected belatedly, and in others because the company initially elected not to disclose it. A separate high-profile incident, a mid-July intrusion into open-source AI repository Hugging Face, was only detected about a week after it took place, according to timelines released by OpenAI and independent investigators. This helped ignite global debate about the risks posed by increasingly powerful AI models. Rivals Anthropic, Google's (GOOGL.O) Gemini, and Meta (META.O) have also disclosed incidents of their agents accessing external systems. Some of America's top AI executives, including Altman, have called for a [USN:L6N45604K TEXT:"slowdown"] of industry development, citing, among other factors, the threat of devastating cyber attacks by out-of-control agents.

item.title: Kane considers NFL kicking career after soccer
item.description: England captain Harry Kane said on Wednesday he is considering a future as an NFL kicker later in his career, with a possible spell in Major League Soccer potentially helping him make the transition.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: England captain Harry Kane said on Wednesday he is considering a future as an NFL kicker later in his career, with a possible spell in Major League Soccer potentially helping him make the transition. Kane had previously expressed his interest in pursuing careers in golf and American football. Now the 33-year-old is giving more serious thought to a future in the NFL, though he stressed any potential move to the United States is still several years away. "That is something I will try and look at a bit more seriously," Kane told reporters at England's training camp. "It all depends on what happens in my career over the next five or six years. The NFL is a lot more realistic than the golf one, let's put it that way." The Bayern Munich striker said his penalty-taking experience could give him a head start as an NFL kicker, though switching sports would take serious preparation. "I take penalties and it is a very similar pressure and technique," he said. "In terms of training, I would be closer to that more than any other sport. "But, with all elite sports, when you watch it on TV, people make it look easy; you think it is possible, but that is not always the case. "If I was to do it, it is something I would take seriously. I would take maybe six months to a year of trying to practice before." Kane also suggested a move to MLS could provide a way to combine the two sports. "Maybe if I am in the MLS in the future or somewhere like that it might be a thing where you could connect the two maybe with the seasons," he said. There are already examples of soccer players making the switch. Dallas Cowboys kicker Brandon Aubrey was a first-round MLS draft pick by Toronto FC in 2017 but never made an official appearance for the first team. Jake Bates also played college soccer before becoming a kicker for the Detroit Lions. Kane's immediate future, however, remains in soccer, with talks over a new contract at Bundesliga champions Bayern progressing and an announcement expected soon. "We're in good talks," Kane said. "There's still some things that we need to iron out. I'm happy there. I think it won't be too long before there's some sort of announcement."

item.title: ＥＣＢ、会社法の欧州共通化を支持 生産性向上の必要性強調
item.description: [フランクフルト ２３日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）は２３日、欧州連合（ＥＵ）が提案している、域内全域に共...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ、会社法の欧州共通化を支持　生産性向上の必要性強調 5:30 配信

３月１９日撮影　REUTERS/Jana Rodenbusch

[フランクフルト　２３日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）は２３日、欧州連合（ＥＵ）が提案している、域内全域に共通した会社法を導入する取り組み「ＥＵ　Ｉｎｃ」を支持すると明らかにした。ＥＣＢは、米国企業に比べて劣っているとされる欧州企業の生産性を向上させる必要性を強調し、国境を越えた事業活動を支援することで「競争力強化やイノベーション、生産性の向上で、単一市場を支える可能性がある」と指摘した。

１９９５年にはほぼ同水準だったＥＵと米国の労働者の生産性は、足元では米国に２０％程度劣っているとされる。一般的に大企業は中小企業に比べて生産性が高い例が多く、ＥＣＢは、ＥＵの大企業と中小企業の構成比率が米国と同程度となれば、米国との生産性を巡る格差のうち、約３分の１を埋める計算になるとの見解を示した。

従業員２５０人以上の企業は、従業員１人当たり年間８万６８００ユーロの付加価値を生み出しているのに対し、１０人未満の企業ではその半分にも満たないとされる。

ＥＣＢは、欧州でのイノベーションの欠如や域内各国でまちまちの規制、資本市場の整備の遅れなどが、企業の成長や国際的な競争力強化を阻む要因となっていると指摘した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ＥＵのＥＶ補助金巡る対中調査、自らに跳ね返るリスクも コラム：短距離フライト削減でＣＯ2対策なるか、的外れの欧州 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 焦点：コーヒー企業「アフリカ離れ」も、ＥＵが森林破壊防止法 アングル：長時間労働・残業に不満の中国労働者、ＥＵの対中圧力に「共感」 最終更新: 9/24(木) 5:30 ロイター

AI firms should not get regulatory waivers, Nvidia CEO says on podcast

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang speaks at Dreamforce 2026 summit in San Francisco, California, U.S., September 15, 2026. REUTERS/Carlos Barria

FAST

SAN FRANCISCO, Sept 23 : Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang believes AI firms should not receive exemptions from antitrust or liability laws, according to a podcast released on Wednesday. In a nearly two-hour interview with New York Times podcast host Ezra Klein, Huang, CEO of the world's most valuable publicly listed company, had an extensive discussion about OpenAI agents that hacked Hugging Face, the open-source AI software hub that Nvidia purchased for $13 billion this month. Huang, who has opposed blanket AI safety regulation even as labs such as OpenAI and Anthropic have called for it, reiterated his position that it is the responsibility of AI labs to test their products and only release models once they are satisfied models are safe. "However, in the complexity of the work that they do, to ask for regulatory relief for antitrust or product liability relief — that I don’t think makes sense. When you’re asking for regulation, don’t ask for relief of the current ones," Huang said, according to a transcript published by the newspaper.

In an essay published this month, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for an antitrust waiver allowing AI labs to work together on safety issues. Some U.S. officials such as Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent have said AI firms have asked for liability shields, without naming specific firms. In other portions of the interview, Nvidia's Huang said that he is not opposed to regulations for specific products where AI is applied, such as self-driving cars. "The car as a product — the robo-taxi — has lots of regulations. If it doesn’t have enough regulations, then NHTSA ought to get involved and come up with new regulations," Huang said. "The car industry should have new regulations. I don’t know what’s missing, but if there is something missing, then I would absolutely add more regulation."

item.title: ＡＩ大手3社幹部、安保理で警鐘 「制御不能なら人類への脅威」
item.description:
Michelle Nichols Courtney Rozen John Irish
[国連 ２３日 ロイター] - ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ大手3社幹部、安保理で警鐘　「制御不能なら人類への脅威」 5:24 配信

2026年9月23日、国連安全保障理事会に出席したOpenAIのサム・アルトマンCEO。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid

Michelle Nichols　Courtney Rozen　John Irish

[国連 ２３日 ロイター] - 世界有数のＡＩ（人工知能）企業各社幹部が２３日、ＡＩが人類にもたらすリスクについて国連安全保障理事会で警告し、この技術を管理するために各国政府が協調するよう訴えた。

年次の国連総会に合わせて開催された会合で、オープンＡＩのサム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）、アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイＣＥＯ、ハギングフェイス共同創業者のクレマン・ドゥラング氏という業界を代表する３人が発言した。

アンソロピックのアモデイ氏は「うまく管理できなければ、ＡＩは人類全体にとってリスクとなり得るとさえ考えている」と述べた。さらに、「この場にいる人々の間にあらゆる違いがあるとしても、同時に突き付けられているこの世界的な機会と脅威に立ち向かうため、われわれはそうした違いを脇に置かなければならない。いかなる指導者も、いかなる企業も、いかなる国家も、これに単独で対処することはできない」と述べた。

ハギングフェイスのドゥラング氏は、サイバー攻撃を防ぐ上でのＡＩツールの役割を強調した。その例として、米大手オープンＡＩのＡＩエージェントがテスト環境を脱し、ハギングフェイスのインフラに侵入した事案を挙げた。

ドゥラング氏は「われわれはＡＩに攻撃されたが、より重要なのは、われわれがＡＩで自らを守ったことだ」と述べた。ドゥラング氏によると、ハギングフェイスはオープンＡＩのＡＩエージェントによる攻撃を防ぐ際、中国製のＡＩモデルを使用した。同等の米国製ツールに比べて制約が少なかったためだという。同氏の発言は、中国製ＡＩ製品の存在感が高まっていることを浮き彫りにした。中国製品は米国製モデルより低コストの代替手段を提供できることもあり、世界的に利用者を増やしている。

オープンＡＩのアルトマンＣＥＯは「ＡＩが民主的であるべきなら、最も重要な決定をサンフランシスコの研究所だけで下すことはできない。そうした決定は民主的なプロセスを通じ、国民に責任を負う政府によって形作られるべきだ。国際的なレベルでは、これには協力が必要になる」と訴えた。

同氏はさらに「われわれの歴史の中で、互いに競争し、必ずしも仲が良いわけでもない国々が、強力な新技術を前にして共通の利益と全体の善のために結束したことが何度もあった。今こそがまさにその時であると考える」と述べた。

国連の「ＡＩに関する独立国際科学パネル」の共同議長を務めるヨシュア・ベンジオ氏は安保理で「危険は現実に存在し、差し迫っている。安保理は前例のない脅威に直面している。それはどの加盟国も望まない脅威であり、単独で封じ込められる国はなく、われわれが守る国境も尊重しない脅威だ」と警戒感を示した。

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル一時約2カ月ぶり高値、原油急伸 円は158円台前半に下落
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２３日 ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが約２カ月ぶりの高値まで上昇した。イラン当局...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル一時約2カ月ぶり高値、原油急伸　円は158円台前半に下落 5:22 配信

コロンビア・ボゴタにある両替所で2025年6月撮影。REUTERS/Nathalia Angarita

［ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが約２カ月ぶりの高値まで上昇した。イラン当局者の発言を受けて和平交渉の進展に対する懸念が広がり、原油価格が急伸する中、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による短期的な利上げ観測が強まった。

ＦＲＢは先週、約３年ぶりの利上げに踏み切ったが、ＦＲＢ当局者からはその後も、インフレが鈍化しなければ追加利上げの可能性があるとの発言が相次いでいる。バーＦＲＢ理事は２３日、ＦＲＢが先週の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げを決めたことについて、インフレ抑制に向けて金利を「再調整」する重要な一歩を踏み出したと評価。その上で、さらなる利上げが必要になる公算が大きいと述べた。

ブラウン・ブラザーズ・ハリマンのグローバル・マーケット・ストラテジー責任者、エリアス・ハダッド氏は「現時点では金利の話が中心だ」と指摘。その上で「ドル高を主導しているのは、先週のタカ派的なＦＲＢの利上げの流れであり、それがドルに新たな勢いを与えている。今週は目立った経済指標や政策関連のデータはなかったが、興味深かったのはＦＲＢ高官の発言で、全員が追加利上げが視野に入っているとの姿勢を示している」と述べた。

この日発表の経済指標では、Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルの９月の米総合購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）速報値は５８．４と、前月の５６．０から上昇し、２０２１年７月以来の高水準となった。これを受け、ドルは上げ幅を拡大した。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、ＦＲＢが１０月の会合で少なくとも２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の追加利上げを実施するとの確率は約７０％と、ＰＭＩ発表前の約５３％から上昇した。

また、この日の原油価格の上昇もドル高に寄与。イラン国家安全保障最高評議会のモフセン・レザイ書記が国営テレビとのインタビューで、周辺国が米国に協力してイラン便の運航を停止させれば、イランはそれらの国の空港が機能しないようにすると述べたことが材料となった。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．５１％高の１０１．０６。一時、７月２９日以来の高値となる１０１．２３を付けた。

ドルは対円では０．５２％高の１ドル＝１５８．１９円。日銀が先週、政策金利を３１年ぶりの高水準に引き上げたものの、市場が追加利上げの可能性があるとの安心感を得るには不十分だったことから円安が進行しており、円買い為替介入の兆候に警戒感が高まっている。

ユーロは０．５１％安の１．１３８９ドルと、３営業日連続の下落となり、１週間で最大の下げとなる見通しとなった。

オフショア取引でドルは対中国人民元で０．１７％高の１ドル＝６．７１元。

item.title: 米国株式市場＝下落、利回り上昇が重し アルファベット・アマゾンが安い
item.description:
Noel Randewich
［ニューヨーク ２３日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は下落。大型ハイテク株のアルファベッ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝下落、利回り上昇が重し　アルファベット・アマゾンが安い 5:19 配信

9月16日、ニューヨーク証券取引所の取引フロアで撮影。にある椅子に、ジャケットが掛けられている。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

Noel Randewich

［ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は下落。大型ハイテク株のアルファベットとアマゾン・ドット・コムが下げを主導した。米債利回りの上昇が重しとなったほか、イランのペゼシュキアン大統領が国連総会の一般討論演説で、米国との戦争でイランが降伏することはないと表明したことを受け、中東情勢を巡る警戒感が強まった。

ペゼシュキアン氏の演説を受け、原油価格が４％近く上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００のエネルギーセクターは上昇した。

この日発表された９月の米総合購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）が５年余りぶりの高水準となったことを受け、米国債利回りが上昇。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１０月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げに動くとの観測が強まった。

ファウンダーズ１００ＥＴＦのローレン・キャシディ最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は「株式市場は（中東）紛争の解決を望んでいる。それが実現しなければ、より長期間にわたり金利が高止まりし、株式市場の重しになり続けるだろう」と述べた。

メタ・プラットフォームズは１％高となり、今週の上昇率は１２％に達した。人工知能（ＡＩ）アシスタント「ミューズ」が好感されたためで、アナリストによると、ハイテクインフラ関連株には追い風となる一方、銀行やオンラインショッピングプラットフォーム、その他の消費者向け事業には脅威となる可能性がある。

グーグルの親会社アルファベットは３．８％下落した。ミューズを自社のショッピングプラットフォームから締め出したアマゾン・ドット・コムは２．２％安となった。

フィラデルフィア半導体株指数は１．２％下落。半導体大手エヌビディアは１．５％安となった。

エクスペディアとエアビーアンドビーはともに７％超下落した。

ナスダック総合指数は過去２営業日連続で終値の最高値を更新していた。ウォール街ではＡＩ関連企業に対する楽観的な見方が続いていた。Ｓ＆Ｐ５００は、８月１３日に付けた終値ベースの最高値から２％以内の水準にある。

トランプ米大統領は２３日、３日間の日程でワシントンを訪問する中国の習近平国家主席を迎える。会談では、２０２５年に成立した米中貿易休戦の延長、ＡＩ規制、台湾への米国の武器売却などが議題となる。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１セクターでは公益事業や通信サービスの下げが目立った。

米取引所の合算出来高は１７０億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１６５億株。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．９対１の比率で上回った。

item.title: Trump to raise detainees with Xi, but other rights issues may not come up
item.description: President Donald Trump is expected to press Chinese leader Xi Jinping to free two US citizens held by China, but it is not clear whether other human-rights issues will get similar attention during this week's summit.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh, Jonathan Landay, Patricia Zengerle
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump is expected to press Chinese leader Xi Jinping to free two US citizens held by China, but it is not clear whether other human-rights issues will get similar attention during this week's summit. In a preview of Xi's visit last Friday, a US official said Trump is likely to bring up cases of people wrongfully detained in China with Xi. However, the White House has not said whether Trump will directly raise broader rights issues related to Tibet, the Uyghur Muslim minority group, and the country's new "ethnic unity" law. Trump has made winning freedom for Americans held overseas a priority, including in China, advocates say. But the Republican leader has largely avoided talking about China's rights record, and has not publicly [USN:L1N3WT0YK TEXT:"brought up"] rights issues when meeting other world leaders like Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Trump will ask Xi to free Youlin Chen, a Chinese-born expert on North Korean nuclear tests who has been imprisoned since late 2024, and Min Zin, a scholar arrested in June, according to Chen's wife, Yufang Rong. Both are US citizens. Trump raised Chen's case when he met Xi in Beijing in May but nothing has happened since then, she said. "We hope to see Dr. Chen and Zin come home after this meeting," said Elizabeth Richards, research director of the James Foley Foundation, a hostage advocacy group. Human rights groups and Democratic lawmakers say Trump must also press Xi on China's treatment of Tibetans and Uyghurs and speak up for Hong Kong pro-democracy protesters. Democrats in Congress say Trump is soft-pedaling human rights concerns and taking a transactional approach to international affairs. "We cannot abandon human rights in our foreign policy," Democratic Representative Jim McGovern of Massachusetts said on Wednesday. "China's record is beyond debate and it is atrocious." Beijing has signaled that the topic will be off limits. The country's ambassador to the US warned on Wednesday that democracy and human rights are [USN:L1N45E11E TEXT:""red lines""] that cannot be crossed. Human rights groups say China has [USN:KCN1LF1EP TEXT:"detained Uyghurs"] on the pretext of countering extremism and confined them in re-education camps. US secretaries of state from both parties have labeled the [USN:L4N2SV02I TEXT:"treatment of Uyghurs as genocide"]. "Xi's visit to Washington is a strategic moment to move beyond words of condemnation on the Uyghur genocide," World Uyghur Congress President Turgunjan Alawdun said. China's embassy in Washington did not respond to a request for comment. Beijing says it has established "vocational training centers" to curb extremism and denies abuse allegations. Rights groups and exiles also routinely describe China's rule in Tibet as "oppressive," an accusation that Beijing rejects. China has exerted greater control over the region since Xi became chief of the Communist Party in 2012. Beijing says Washington should stop using "Tibet-related issues to interfere in China's internal affairs." The International Campaign for Tibet called on Trump to ask Xi "to resume substantive dialogue without preconditions" with the [USN:L4N43A1QL TEXT:"Dalai Lama"], the spiritual head of Tibetan Buddhists and a Nobel Peace Prize laureate. The State Department reiterated calls for such dialogue when a Tibetan American [USN:L1N43501X TEXT:"died"] after setting himself on fire in July. China passed a [USN:L4N3ZZ0C5 TEXT:"law"] this year to create a shared national identity among the country's 55 ethnic minority groups, which includes penalties for people outside the country for "inciting ethnic separatism." The State Department calls the law problematic. Katie LaRoque, director for policy and advocacy at Freedom House, urged Trump to condemn the legislation himself. "President Trump must make clear that Beijing’s domestic law has no jurisdiction over those exercising their fundamental freedoms on US soil," she said.

Sept 23 : Anthropic on Wednesday said its Claude model helped discover a novel enzyme system with properties reminiscent of mechanisms in gene-editing technology CRISPR, marking the first result from the AI startup's biology research efforts.  The finding comes days after Reuters reported Anthropic had quietly established a wet lab in the San Francisco Bay Area, as the company expands its ambitions in life sciences and drug-related research beyond purely computer-based work. • Anthropic said Claude analyzed large DNA databases and found an unusual system built around a reverse transcriptase (RT), an enzyme that copies RNA into DNA. • Anthropic has named the system array-associated reverse transcriptases, or ART.

NEW YORK, Sept 23 : Private equity firm Hellman & Friedman is exploring a sale of insurance software provider Applied Systems that could value the company at up to $10 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. The private equity firm is working with investment bankers at JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs on the process, which has attracted interest from prospective buyers, said the sources, who requested anonymity because the matter is confidential. Applied Systems, Hellman & Friedman, JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs declined to comment. Headquartered in Chicago, Applied Systems provides software that helps insurance agencies and brokerages manage customer relationships, policy administration, and other workflows. Its customers include insurance brokerages such as HUB International, Insurance Office of America, and the Baldwin Group, according to its website.

Applied Systems generates more than $550 million in annual earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, one of the sources said. Hellman & Friedman bought Applied Systems from Bain Capital in a deal valued at approximately $1.8 billion in early 2014. A sale would rank among the largest software buyout processes this year and test investor appetite for mature software assets, following ServiceNow's $7.7 billion acquisition of cybersecurity provider Armis and buyout firm Hg's $6.4 billion take-private of financial software provider OneStream. Sell-side activity in the software sector has picked up in recent weeks after being relatively muted over the past months, with more companies launching sale processes.  This month, Reuters reported that Thoma Bravo was exploring a sale of Foundation Software, Vista Equity Partners was considering a sale of banking software provider Finastra, and healthcare software company Waystar was weighing strategic options, including a sale, as sponsors seek to capitalize on improving valuations.

item.title: Europeans warn of rising Russian sabotage but see no imminent NATO attack
item.description: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said Russia is increasing cyberattacks, sabotage and drone incursions "to scare Europe into winding down its support for Ukraine."
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Europeans warn of rising Russian sabotage but see no imminent NATO attack

EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said Russia is increasing cyberattacks, sabotage and drone incursions "to scare Europe into winding down its support for Ukraine."

EU European Commission Vice-President Kaja Kallas on the sidelines of the ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting at the Philippine International Convention Centre on Jul 24, 2026 in Pasay, Metro Manila, Philippines. (Photo: REUTERS/Ezra Acayan)

UNITED NATIONS: Russia is intensifying sabotage, cyberattacks and other hybrid attacks across Europe to undermine support for Ukraine, European ministers said, while dismissing concerns that Moscow is capable of launching a direct assault on NATO. Speaking on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly this week, officials from countries on NATO's eastern flank said Moscow was increasingly using drone incursions, cyberattacks, sabotage and other covert operations to sow fear, test Western resolve and weaken backing for Kyiv. "Europe faces a fast proliferation of sabotage attacks and airspace violations," EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas told reporters. "Moscow is trying to scare Europe into winding down its support for Ukraine." European governments increasingly see Russia's most immediate threat not as a conventional military attack, but as a campaign of covert and deniable actions aimed at unsettling Ukraine's allies and eroding Western unity as the war drags on.

Kallas said Russia appeared willing to take greater risks and argued the answer was to increase pressure on Moscow through tougher sanctions, including measures targeting its "shadow fleet" and military-industrial complex. "Russia's economy is one of its weakest parts, and we need to increase the pressure on it so that they would stop this war," she said. Polish Foreign Minister Radoslaw Sikorski said such activity was no longer merely a threat. "They're not just threats; they're actual attacks," Sikorski told Reuters, citing arson, explosions, drone incursions and what Warsaw says was a deliberate cruise missile violation of its territory.

A Russian Mi-8 military helicopter flies in Syria's northeastern Hasakeh province on Feb 4, 2021. (Photo: AFP/Delil Souleiman)

The Polish Army Operational Command said on Wednesday (Sep 23) a Russian military Mi-8 helicopter made a brief incursion into its airspace from the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad. "Our F-16s are scrambled up almost every day now because you just never know when these drones or missiles that approach might not actually be possible," he said. Romanian Foreign Minister Oana Toiu told Reuters Bucharest had seen more than 100 incursions by drones or drone fragments onto its territory as Russia intensified attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure near the Danube and Black Sea. "We do not have data to indicate we're targeted directly, but that doesn't change the responsibility of Russia for the risk it creates," she said. Romania has responded by closing Russia's consulate in Constanta and coordinating diplomatic measures with European allies, she added. The Kremlin consistently denies conducting sabotage operations in NATO countries or plotting any confrontation.

NO IMMINENT NATO ATTACK Despite the incidents, ministers drew a distinction between Russia's covert campaign and the prospect of a direct attack on NATO territory. Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna told Reuters alarmist predictions of an imminent Russian assault on the alliance were misplaced. "We don’t see that Russia is able and even preparing for some kind of active military aggression against NATO or the European countries," he said, arguing Moscow lacked the capabilities for such an operation while its forces remained heavily engaged in Ukraine. He said Moscow's campaign was designed primarily to create fear and divisions within Western societies. "This is mainly meant for creating fear, fear of escalation, to divide us, to play with our unity," Tsahkna said. "The main message is: Don't let Putin play with the fear of escalation," he said, referring to Russian President Vladimir Putin. Lithuanian Foreign Minister Kestutis Budrys said allied intelligence pointed to a risk that Russia could seek to broaden pressure on NATO countries through attacks on critical infrastructure and other forms of hybrid activity. "There are some considerations on the Russian side to escalate horizontally, so to say, or geographically," Budrys told Reuters. The ministers said the best way to counter such tactics was through unity, deterrence and continued support for Ukraine, particularly ahead of winter, when Russia is expected to intensify attacks on energy infrastructure. Budrys warned that "the cold will be weaponized by Russia" and urged European countries to provide more assistance, arguing support remained patchy across the bloc. Several ministers argued that firm responses had already shown results. Tsahkna pointed to the sharp reduction in serious Russian airspace violations on NATO's eastern flank following a strong allied reaction to previous incidents. "Putin is carefully watching," he said. "We have lots of leverage, but we just need to have self-confidence and be clear about our language."

item.title: Líderes da área de IA alertam ONU sobre riscos à segurança conforme sistemas se tornam mais poderosos
item.description: As principais empresas de inteligência artificial do mundo alertaram o Conselho de Segurança das Nações Unidas, nesta quarta-feira, sobre os riscos que a IA representa para a humanidade, apelando para que os governos trabalhem em conjunto para gerenciar essa tecnologia cada vez mais poderosa.
item.dc:creator: Michelle Nichols, Courtney Rozen, John Irish
item.content:encoded: As principais empresas de inteligência artificial do mundo alertaram o Conselho de Segurança das Nações Unidas, nesta quarta-feira, sobre os riscos que a IA representa para a humanidade, apelando para que os governos trabalhem em conjunto para gerenciar essa tecnologia cada vez mais poderosa. O presidente-executivo da Anthropic, Dario Amodei, disse ao conselho de 15 membros — responsável por manter a paz e a segurança internacionais — que, se mal gerenciada, ele acreditava que “a IA poderia ser um risco para a humanidade como um todo”. A reunião — convocada pela França durante o encontro anual da Assembleia Geral da ONU com líderes mundiais — ocorre em meio a alertas de que os sistemas de IA poderiam em breve se aperfeiçoar e escapar do controle humano. “Apesar de todas as diferenças entre as pessoas presentes nesta sala, devemos deixar essas diferenças de lado para enfrentar essa oportunidade global e essa ameaça global que nos são apresentadas ao mesmo tempo. Nenhum líder, nenhuma empresa e nenhuma nação pode lidar com isso sozinho”, afirmou Amodei. Governos em todo o mundo têm enfrentado dificuldades para acompanhar os rápidos avanços na inteligência artificial. Os Estados Unidos e a China, as duas principais potências no desenvolvimento de IA, adotaram abordagens diferentes em relação à regulamentação. O presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, argumentou que os EUA não precisam de novas regulamentações específicas para a IA, enquanto a China impôs regras que regem algoritmos de IA e dados de treinamento, incluindo a exigência de que conteúdos gerados por IA sejam claramente identificados. O cofundador da Hugging Face, Clément Delangue, destacou o papel das ferramentas de IA na defesa contra ataques cibernéticos, citando um incidente em que agentes de IA da gigante norte-americana OpenAI invadiram a infraestrutura da Hugging Face após escaparem de seu ambiente de testes. “Fomos atacados pela IA, mas, mais importante, nos defendemos com a IA”, disse ele ao conselho. Membros do conselho, incluindo os principais rivais em IA — os Estados Unidos e a China —, também estavam programados para se manifestar. Delangue disse que a Hugging Face contou com um modelo de IA chinês para ajudar na defesa contra o ataque dos agentes de IA da OpenAI, pois ele enfrentava menos restrições do que ferramentas norte-americanas comparáveis. Suas falas ressaltaram a crescente presença de produtos de IA chineses, que conquistaram usuários em todo o mundo, em parte porque podem oferecer alternativas de menor custo aos modelos norte-americanos. O presidente-executivo da OpenAI, Sam Altman, afirmou que a cooperação internacional é necessária. “Para que a IA seja democrática, as decisões mais importantes não podem ser tomadas apenas por laboratórios em São Francisco. Elas devem ser moldadas por meio de processos democráticos e por governos que prestem contas ao povo que servem”, disse Altman ao conselho. Enquanto o conselho se reunia, o primeiro-ministro australiano, Anthony Albanese, disse a repórteres em Nova York que um agente de IA desenvolvido pela OpenAI se infiltrou em um site do governo australiano em junho, acessando arquivos públicos e não públicos. EUA À ONU: NÃO É POSSÍVEL REGULAR UMA TECNOLOGIA QUE VOCÊS NÃO COMPREENDEM Yoshua Bengio, canadense considerado um dos “padrinhos da IA” e copresidente do Painel Científico Internacional Independente — criado pela Assembleia Geral da ONU no ano passado —, disse ao Conselho de Segurança: “Os perigos são reais e iminentes.” “Este conselho enfrenta uma ameaça sem precedentes, que nenhum de seus membros escolheria, que ninguém pode conter sozinho e que não respeita as fronteiras que defendemos”, disse ele. Trump disse aos líderes mundiais na Assembleia Geral da ONU na terça-feira que “rejeita qualquer tentativa de construir um esquema globalista para controlar” a IA, descrevendo a tecnologia como incrível, mas observando que os EUA seriam cautelosos. O assessor de ciência e tecnologia da Casa Branca, Michael Kratsios, ecoou as palavras de Trump em declarações ao Conselho de Segurança da ONU nesta quarta-feira. “Não se pode governar uma tecnologia que não se compreende. Este órgão e outros semelhantes devem se concentrar no compartilhamento das melhores práticas para desenvolver capacidade nacional, e não no estabelecimento de um esquema regulatório global”, afirmou. O embaixador da China na ONU, Fu Cong, afirmou que é necessária uma melhoria contínua das estruturas regulatórias, da resposta a emergências e da cooperação transfronteiriça em matéria de IA. “Cabe à comunidade internacional trabalhar em conjunto de forma mais estreita, atribuir igual importância ao desenvolvimento e à segurança e orientar o desenvolvimento da IA para o lado positivo, para o bem e para a humanidade”, disse ele ao Conselho de Segurança. O secretário-geral da ONU, António Guterres, que há muito vem defendendo a governança global da IA, alertou que o rápido avanço da inteligência artificial representa riscos que não podem ser ignorados, o que o coloca em desacordo com Trump. O Conselho de Segurança se reuniu pela primeira vez para discutir os riscos da IA em 2023, quando a China afirmou que a tecnologia não deveria se tornar um “cavalo fora de controle” e os Estados Unidos alertaram contra seu uso para censurar ou reprimir as pessoas. O então secretário de Estado dos EUA, Antony Blinken, presidiu uma reunião do Conselho de Segurança sobre IA em 2024.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（23日） 3:56 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

下落して取引を終えた。ＦＴＳＥ１００種は横ばい圏ながら続落。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．６７％安と反落した。原油先物価格の上昇を受けたインフレ懸念が相場の重荷となった。

米イランが間接協議を開き、戦闘終結に向けた進展への期待が高まったものの、双方とも姿勢の転換を示さなかった。原油価格が上昇したほか、英１０年債利回りは一時５．３５３％を付けた。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種石油・ガス株指数は２．２１％高。石油大手のＢＰは２．７％、シェルは２．０％それぞれ上昇した。航空宇宙・防衛株指数は１．３７％高。エンジンメーカーのロールスロイスは１．４％値上がりした。

一方、製薬・バイオテクノロジー株指数は１．５１％安。製薬大手アストラゼネカは１．９％、ＧＳＫ は１．０％それぞれ下落した。

小売りのＪＤスポーツ・ファッションは５．７％安。足元の減益決算を受け、売られた。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

反落して取引を終えた。米イラン情勢に進展の兆しが見られず、原油高と国債利回りの再上昇が相場の重荷となった。主要な地域指数はいずれも下落した。

トランプ米大統領は国連総会で２２日、イランが戦闘終結に向けた合意に応じなければ「壊滅させる」と警告。一方、イランのペゼシュキアン大統領は２３日、米国の圧力に決して屈しないと表明した。５営業日連続で下落していたブレント原油先物は再び１バレル＝１００ドルを超えた。ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは一時３．５５０％を付けた。

大半の業種が下落し、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種銀行株指数は０．４４％、保険株指数は１．７０％、建設・資材株指数は１．２７％、いずれも下落した。一方、石油・ガス株指数は１．２９％上昇した。

オランダの建設コンサルティング会社アルカディスは２．９％安。カナダのエンジニアリング企業ＷＳＰグローバルによる買収提案の取り下げを受け、売られた。

次期の最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）を発表したオランダの決済サービス会社アディエンは４．７％安だった。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りが上昇した。原油価格が再び上昇したことに加え、ユーロ圏と米国の両方で予想を上回る経済活動指標が発表され、利上げ観測が強まった。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが発表したユーロ圏の９月の総合購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）速報値は下落予想に反して５３．１に急上昇し、２０２３年４月以来の高水準を記録した。

９月の米ＰＭＩ速報値は５８．４と、前月の５６．０から上昇し、２１年７月以来の高水準となった。

ＤＺバンクのアナリスト、ルネ・アルブレヒト氏は、「今朝発表されたドイツ、フランス、ユーロ圏全体のＰＭＩデータは、特にサービス部門において予想外に堅調だった」と指摘。「ＰＭＩデータが（債券売りの）一因となったことはたしかだ」と述べた。

市場が依然として中東情勢を注視する中、原油価格は６日ぶりに上昇。ブレント原油先物は２．４％高の１バレル＝１０１．６４ドルとなった。

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのナーゲル独連銀総裁は２２日、エネルギー価格の高騰でインフレ率が目標を上回って推移していることを受け、ＥＣＢが金融政策を巡る判断を行うに当たり原油価格が一段と重要な指標になっているとの認識を示した。

市場はＥＣＢが年内に計約３５ｂｐの追加利上げを実施するとの見方を織り込んでいる。ＰＭＩデータ発表前よりわずかに高い水準となったものの、１８日の約４０ｂｐからは低下している。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは８ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の３．５３２％。

ＥＣＢの政策金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りは７．５ｂｐ上昇の３．２８３％。

フランス１０年債利回りは１２ｂｐ上昇の４．６１３％と、０８年以来の高水準となった。

フランスは２７年の選挙年を控え、議会の分裂による財政リスクに直面しており、ここ数週間で市場の警戒感が一段と強まっている。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は１０８ｂｐまで拡大した。

item.title: US drafted a memo condemning UK over West Bank sanctions. It was never released
item.description: In early September, US officials in Jerusalem and Washington prepared a draft statement attributed to Secretary of State Marco Rubio condemning plans by the UK, France and Canada to block imports from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank.
item.dc:creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Alexander Cornwell
item.content:encoded: In early September, US officials in Jerusalem and Washington prepared a draft statement attributed to Secretary of State Marco Rubio condemning plans by the UK, France and Canada to block imports from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. The September 8 dated document, previously unreported and which two sources said was driven by David Milstein, an influential aide to US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee, proposed that Rubio describe the countries' [USN:S8N42N05Y TEXT:"actions"] as a series of hostile measures against Israel that contribute to antisemitism. "These tactics unacceptably draw from the playbook of the antisemitic boycotts, divestments and sanctions movement," the draft document, reviewed by Reuters, said. The statement was never released. According to three people familiar with the matter, the statement was not supported by the White House and the State Department's senior leadership. The people spoke on condition of anonymity. Instead, speaking to reporters on September 8 in Florida before traveling to Latin America, Rubio refrained from outright criticism of the decision or any particular country. "Obviously, we’re not going to do what the UK did. We saw their announcement today, but I don’t have any comment on it right now," Rubio said. The episode illustrates a widening divide between the White House and Trump's senior diplomats in Israel about how best to respond to the expansion of Israeli settlements under Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing government. It also highlights a growing ideological split within the American right over support for Israel, with polling showing younger Republicans holding an increasingly unfavorable opinion of Washington's closest Middle East ally. President Donald Trump earlier this year expressed his opposition to settlement expansion, a growing source of friction with Israel's Arab neighbors, but his administration has put little pressure on Israel to change its policy. That has at times put him at odds with Huckabee, a Baptist minister who is a staunch supporter of settlements and who refers to the West Bank by its biblical name, Judea and Samaria, a term used by the Israeli government but not formally adopted by the US. Huckabee's aide Milstein last year advocated that the US impose sanctions on the entire International Criminal Court to convince it to drop war crimes charges against Israeli leaders over the Gaza war - a measure the Trump administration has yet to deploy. In response to questions from Reuters, a senior US official said the draft statement was not prepared in consultation with the State Department or White House. The US embassy referred questions, including requests for comment from Huckabee and Milstein, to the State Department. The White House did not respond to a request for comment. US PUBLIC SUPPORT FOR ISRAEL QUESTIONED US public backing for Israel has fallen since the Gaza war began in 2023, particularly among Democrats. A June Quinnipiac University poll found 48% of voters and 66% of Democrats believe the United States is too supportive of Israel, up from 16% and 20% when the question was first asked in 2017. While large majorities of Republicans aged 50 and older view Israel positively, younger conservative Americans have grown more critical, a Pew Research Center poll from late March showed. Some 57% of Republicans aged 18-49 have an unfavorable opinion of Israel, up from 50% a year previously. In December last year, Trump said that he and Netanyahu, whose government has overseen a rapid expansion of settlements, [USN:S0N3XP00A TEXT:"did not"] fully agree on the West Bank following a meeting with the Israeli leader. That September, Trump said he would not allow Israel to annex the territory. Israel has occupied the West Bank since the 1967 Arab-Israeli War. The United Nations and most countries consider settlements to be illegal under international law governing military occupation. Israel rejects this, viewing the territory as disputed rather than occupied. Violence by Jewish settlers against Palestinians in the territory has risen sharply this year, some of them emboldened by support from Netanyahu's right-wing government, which includes ministers who are themselves settlers. Huckabee has publicly [USN:L8N44H0H7 TEXT:"condemned"] the violence and called for perpetrators to be prosecuted. He has also said violent settlers were a minority and do not represent the wider settler community. Some 500,000 Israeli settlers and 3 million Palestinians live in the West Bank, territory Palestinians have long sought for a future state, along with Gaza and East Jerusalem.

item.title: ベッセント米財務長官、中国の何立峰副首相と再び会談－首脳会談前に
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ベッセント米財務長官は23日、中国の何立峰副首相と再び会談した。両氏は米中間の経済協議を主導しており、20日にニューヨークで会談したばかり。今回の協議は、習近平国家主席が米国に到着し、トランプ大統領と会談する数時間前に行われた。

ベッセント氏は会談後、Xへの投稿で、何氏と「実質的な協議」を行ったと説明。「米国の労働者、農家、企業を守る意義ある約束を取り付けるとともに、米国の経済・国家安全保障上の利益を推進することに引き続き重点を置いた」と述べた。

協議はホワイトハウスに近い世界銀行本部で行われたと、事情に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。世銀自体は協議に関与していないという。

ベッセント氏と何氏はそれぞれ1時間余り、世銀内に滞在した。何氏は午前11時40分、李成鋼商務次官（国際貿易交渉代表）とともに本部を出た。その後、廖岷財政次官も退出した。李氏と廖氏はいずれも20日にニューヨークで行われた会談にも出席していた。

ニューヨークでの協議では、米中当局者はAIや貿易、投資を巡る数時間に及ぶ話し合いを前向きに評価した。李氏は「良い雰囲気」で行われたと述べ、ベッセント氏も協議は「非常に成功した」と評価していた。

原題：Bessent Met China’s He for Talks on ‘Unfinished’ Work (Correct)（抜粋）

item.description: WASHINGTON, Sept 23 : FBI data allegedly stolen by the hacking group ShinyHunters carries granular detail about scores of bureau officials’ job assignments, including sensitive work against Chinese spies, Russian intelligence, drug cartels, and more, Reuters has found.The 5,000-line spreadsheet – said by

WASHINGTON, Sept 23 : FBI data allegedly stolen by the hacking group ShinyHunters carries granular detail about scores of bureau officials’ job assignments, including sensitive work against Chinese spies, Russian intelligence, drug cartels, and more, Reuters has found. The 5,000-line spreadsheet – said by the hackers to represent only a small piece of their claimed two- to three-terabyte trove – includes names, addresses, telephone numbers, dates of birth, social security numbers, and emergency contact details for what they claimed were thousands of FBI employees. It also includes details of assignments to specific field offices and, in some cases, to units engaged in high-stakes intelligence, security, or counterespionage work. In a statement, the FBI said it was aware of "a cyber-criminal enterprise group claiming a compromise of the FBIJobs.gov portal and alleged impact to FBI employee personally identifiable information." The bureau said the cause of the breach was still undetermined, but that it was "actively and aggressively investigating the matter." The group said on Tuesday that it had breached the FBI and stolen data on a huge number of current and former FBI employees. It said it is holding the data hostage until the bureau rescinds an unflattering statement about the group issued in May.

Shinyhunters said in a statement Wednesday that it was trying to keep the personnel information from circulating widely in the meantime. Although Reuters has not been able to authenticate the entire spreadsheet, it has been able to individually verify the details of more than 22 people by cross-referencing information in the hacked data with credit records and previous data leaks carried by the dark web intelligence platform District 4 Labs.

item.title: モルガンSの投資銀案件リスト流出、従業員が誤送信－SNSにも画像
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米モルガン･スタンレーがアジアで獲得を目指しているか、動向を追っている100件余りの投資銀行案件を記載した内部文書を同行の従業員が誤って流出させた。事情に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。同行が手掛けようとしている案件の詳細が露呈した形となった。

ブルームバーグ･ニュースが入手し、複数の関係者が内容を確認した資料によると、リストには中国や韓国、インドなどの新規株式公開（IPO）候補企業が挙げられていた。リストはアジア地域が中心だが、欧州や中東、アフリカにも及んでおり、こうした企業を支援するプライベートエクイティー（PE）投資会社や年金基金のほか、棚上げされた案件に関する情報も載っていた。

事情に詳しい関係者によれば、投資銀行部門でアジア太平洋地域のフィナンシャル・スポンサー部門責任者を務めるモハメド・アトマニ氏が今週、取引案件の一覧を一部の顧客に電子メールで送信。その後、メールの取り消しを試みた。ぼかしを入れたコピーもインスタグラムのアカウントに投稿された。

アトマニ氏は、主にPE業界の概況や最近の取引に関する一般的な最新情報を盛り込んだ顧客向けのファイルを送るつもりだったが、誤って社内向けの版を送信した。その一部には、株価に影響を及ぼす可能性もある情報が大量に含まれていた。

香港在勤のマネジングディレクターのアトマニ氏は2018年に同行に入行した。同氏は当初コメントを控え、その後のコメント要請にも応じなかった。

モルガン･スタンレーはブルームバーグ･ニュースへの声明で、顧客情報の機密保持を極めて重視しているとし、「今回の不注意による情報共有に対処するため速やかに措置を講じ、引き続き関係者と協議している」と説明した。

今回の情報流出は、香港での株式売り出しの引き受けやアジアの合併案件で長年にわたり上位に名を連ねてきたモルガン･スタンレーにとって痛恨の失態だ。投資銀部門では通常、見込み顧客の取引詳細は厳重に管理されている。こうしたミスはまれだが、投資銀行部門のチームが扱う情報の秘匿性・繊細さを改めて浮き彫りにしている。

item.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine ready for maritime truce and puts onus on Russia to respond
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine is ready for a ceasefire in the Black Sea and is waiting for Russia’s response.

Zelenskyy says Ukraine ready for maritime truce and puts onus on Russia to respond

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine is ready for a ceasefire in the Black Sea and is waiting for Russia’s response.

Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy participates in a meeting with US President Donald Trump during the 81st United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) in New York City, US, on Sep 22, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Kylie Cooper)

UNITED NATIONS: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told leaders at the United Nations on Wednesday (Sep 23) that Ukraine was ready for a maritime truce in the Black Sea based on proposals by Egypt, India and Türkiye and said it was now up to Russia to respond . Zelenskyy spoke at Ukraine 's Crimean Platform summit on the sidelines of the annual UN General Assembly gathering of world leaders and ahead of a Security Council meeting on Russia 's war in Ukraine , which is now in its fifth year. Ukraine , which fears that Russia plans to pound power and heating facilities with missiles and drones this winter, has been pressing for ceasefires covering attacks on energy infrastructure and shipping in the Black Sea. Zelenskyy said Egypt, India and Türkiye had outlined options to restore safe navigation for merchant shipping in the Black Sea, where cargo movements are at a near st and still due to heavy attacks on ships and port infrastructure by both sides.

"We are waiting for Russia 's response. Ukraine is ready ... to ensure safe shipping and food security in the Black Sea if Russia is ready to take real steps towards de-escalation too. We have to start somewhere," he said. Top wheat importers in Asia, the Middle East and Africa that count on the Black Sea region for wheat have been finding it hard to secure supplies. Global wheat prices have soared. Zelenskyy , who was expected to address the UN General Assembly later on Wednesday, met US President Donald Trump on Tuesday and said they had also discussed a Russia - Ukraine ceasefire on energy-related targets.

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio told reporters after meeting Russia n Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov on Wednesday that both Russia and Ukraine had expressed interest in a limited ceasefire involving grain and energy. The Kremlin has not publicly backed the proposals. Ahead of the Lavrov-Rubio meeting, the Kremlin said there were no grounds for wider Ukraine peace talks, while saying it remained open to such talks. "For now, there are no prerequisites for moving on to a peaceful negotiating track, although we, as the Russia n side, remain open to peace talks," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters. Zelenskyy said on Tuesday that he would be ready to meet Russia n President Vladimir Putin at a trilateral meeting with Trump.

Source: Reuters/fs

item.title: Israeli bulldozers smash Palestinian olive trees ahead of annual harvest
item.description: Palestinian villagers wailed over the mangled remains of their olive trees on Wednesday after Israel's military uprooted them with bulldozers, days ahead of the annual olive harvest, normally a source of joy for Palestinians in the occupied West Bank.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Palestinian villagers wailed over the mangled remains of their olive trees on Wednesday after Israel's military uprooted them with bulldozers, days ahead of the [USN:L8N3W21FE TEXT:"annual olive harvest"], normally a source of joy for Palestinians in the occupied West Bank. Abd Alfattah Tamimi, who owns an olive grove on village land near Ramallah city, watched as a military bulldozer smashed the top of one of his trees and then tore its roots from the ground. "All our olive trees, including the newly planted ones, were uprooted. Also our neighbours', they uprooted them all," Tamimi said, adding that he and his neighbours own nearly 9 acres of land filled with olive trees. "They left us with nothing," he said. Israel's military said it was checking Reuters' request for comment but had not responded by Wednesday evening. In the past, the military has cited the need to clear land of olive trees to prevent security threats or ambushes on troops. Palestinian human rights groups reject this, saying the destruction in effect deprives Palestinian farmers of income from the sale of olives and olive oil while uprooting trees they view as a symbol of their connection to the land. The olive harvest usually begins in the first week of October. Olives are the backbone of Palestinian agriculture, a sector that accounts for around 8% of GDP and more than 60,000 jobs, according to the Palestinian Authority's agriculture ministry. Palestinian activists and farmers expect this year's harvest to be particularly volatile, amid a record surge in Israeli settler attacks on Palestinians and Palestinian resources in the territory. Nather Tamimi, another landowner in the area of Deir Nizam village near Ramallah, said the loss of the trees was particularly painful in that it came so close to the start of the harvest. "From this land, my brothers and I produce 120 drums of olive oil. Our neighbours produce the same," said Tamimi, speaking while looking over his olive grove. "They uprooted trees everywhere, even between the houses," he said.

item.title: 米国債売り加速、利回りは20年ぶり高水準－堅調な統計と入札不調で
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 23日の米金融市場では、米国債の下げが加速した。経済指標が市場予想を上回ったほか、5年債入札の需要が弱かったことを受け、大半の年限で利回りが約20年ぶりの高水準へと上昇した。

S&Pグローバルが発表した9月の米総合購買担当者指数（PMI、速報値）は58.4に上昇し、2021年7月以来の高水準。市場予想の中央値は55.3だった。

この日はまず、原油上昇を背景に高インフレへの懸念が強まり、米国債が売られた。PMIの発表を受けて相場は一段と下落。その後、午後の5年債入札で需要が予想外に低調だったことから、売りに拍車がかかった。

入札結果を受けて5年債利回りは一時、20ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上昇し、2007年以来となる5%台に乗せた。10年債利回りは一時17bp上昇して5.13%と、2007年以来の高水準となった。30年債利回りは11bp上昇して5.41%と、こちらも2007年以来の高水準となり、2004年以来の最高水準まで約4bpに迫った。

SEIインベストメンツで債券投資の責任者を務めるショーン・シムコ氏は「堅調な経済指標、国債供給によって5年債利回りが数十年ぶりの水準まで押し上げられていること、インフレが世界的に根強いという3つの要因が重なった」と指摘。こうした流れに対して、「きょうは貨物列車の前に立ちはだかるようなことはしたくない」と語った。

経済指標に加え、中東情勢の緊迫化に伴う原油価格の上昇を受け、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が追加利上げに動くとの見方が強まった。米連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）は先週、3年ぶりに政策金利を引き上げ、誘導目標レンジを3.75－4%とした。ウォーシュFRB議長は、この措置によって金融緩和の度合いを「幾分縮小した」と説明した。

スワップ市場では現在、今後1年間に0.25ポイントの利上げが3回行われることを完全に織り込んでいるほか、4回目の利上げに備えたヘッジも活発になっている。実際に利上げが4回実施されれば、政策金利の誘導目標レンジは4.75－5%となる。

item.title: 米国、ディーゼル輸出を90日間禁止する計画を策定中－ポリティコ
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米ホワイトハウスは、ディーゼル燃料の輸出を90日間禁止する計画を策定している。政治ニュースサイトのポリティコが匿名の関係者の情報を基に報じた。

ポリティコによると、実際に禁止するための法的手続きはなお不透明だが、トランプ大統領は週末までに禁止措置を打ち出す意向だ。禁止措置が導入されれば、高騰する燃料費の抑制に向けたトランプ政権のこれまでで最も踏み込んだ措置となる。

イランとウクライナでの戦争を背景にディーゼル価格が過去最高水準に上昇する中、トランプ氏は今週、米国のディーゼル輸出禁止を支持するよう側近らに促したと述べていた。ただ、エネルギー業界関係者は、輸出規制による価格押し下げ効果は短期的なものにとどまり、その後は燃料費が一段と上昇するとして、規制の可能性に強く反対している。

全米自動車協会（AAA）によると、米国のディーゼル小売価格は過去最高値を更新し、1ガロン当たり6.50ドルを超えた。

原題：US Prepares Plan for 90-Day Diesel Export Ban, Politico Reports

item.description: Sept 23 : Meta's Muse, the first major consumer product to emerge under Alexandr Wang since he was hired to head its AI efforts last year, has split the fortunes of US stocks this week.Muse, which allows users to delegate tasks such as shopping, travel booking and form-filling to an AI agent, overtook ChatGPT

Meta's Muse rekindles fears over winners and losers as personal AI agent emerges

FAST

Sept 23 : Meta's Muse, the first major consumer product to emerge under Alexandr Wang since he was hired to head its AI efforts last year, has split the fortunes of US stocks this week. Muse, which allows users to delegate tasks such as shopping, travel booking and form-filling to an AI agent, overtook ChatGPT as the top free app on Apple's App Store and Google Play Store in the US and Canada. The app recorded 2.8 million downloads within two weeks of its launch, posting an average daily download growth of 55 per cent in the first 10 days, according to market intelligence company Sensor Tower. Investors worried that Meta's scale could turn Muse into a powerful comparison-shopping tool, enabling consumers to more easily find lower-cost alternatives and weakening the loyalty that often keeps users with incumbent providers.

The development dragged on several sectors this week, while Meta and AI-infrastructure related companies rallied. "Meta has really found lightning in a bottle here and someone who partners with Muse is likely to be a clear beneficiary off the bat to me. As far as net losers, it's just going to take more time to find out," said Michael O'Rourke, chief market strategist at JonesTrading. JITTERS ACROSS SECTORS Financials stocks were the hardest-hit in the previous session and remained under pressure on Wednesday on fears that the AI agent could prompt users to switch to policies with cheaper prices. Big banks such as JPMorgan and Wells Fargo lost more than 3 per cent each so far this week, while brokerage Charles Schwab was down nearly 5 per cent. Insurers such as Marsh and Arthur J. Gallagher were down 2.4 per cent and 4.6 per cent, respectively. Art Hogan, chief market strategist for B. Riley Wealth, however, said those disruption concerns were far-fetched. "If you're going to trust the management of your finances to something that Muse found for you, then you were likely not a big payer to anyone in that industry to begin with. There's a whole lot more that goes in asset management than who's got the cheapest price," he said. Booking companies such as TripAdvisor and Booking Holdings, which rely on subscription models, have lost over 6 per cent this week. Planet Fitness has tanked 17 per cent, while the New York Times is down 10 per cent. Other decliners included ride-hailing companies such as Uber and Lyft, and online food marketplace DoorDash. THE BIGGEST WINNERS Meta's shares have soared nearly 13 per cent this week and are set for their fifth-straight week of advances. The gains were fueled by expectations that the mainstream consumer-focused app could generate additional annual revenue, with Truist Securities estimating it to touch at least $28.5 billion by fiscal 2030. US-listed shares of Canada's Shopify have jumped 11.4 per cent this week, after it said it would use Muse to process checkouts. Payments platform PayPal has marginally gained after saying it would allow users to discover products and complete purchases through the AI agent. Privately held companies, including Stripe and Ticketmaster, also struck similar deals with Meta. MORE AI INFRASTRUCTURE DEMAND Apps such as Muse could drive AI compute demand, accelerating AI infrastructure buildout and benefiting chip stocks. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index has gained 7 per cent since Muse's launch and is set for its biggest two-week run since mid-August, with Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices among top gainers.

Source: Reuters
