このプロジェクトは社内で技術調査と呼ばれる初期段階にある。アップルが製品化に踏み切った場合でも、発売は2028年以降になる見通し。同社の広報担当者はコメントを控えた。

試作品は、センサーを搭載した演算モジュールを薄い布製バンドに組み込んだ仕様となっている。画面を持たない点が、フィットネス記録に加えてアプリや通知などの機能を備えるApple Watchとの大きな違いになる。

フープの競合製品となり得るこの端末には、アップルのティム・クック会長とサービス部門トップのエディ・キュー氏が特に関心を示しているという。キュー氏は昨年終盤、同社のヘルスケア事業を統括する立場に就いた。

アップルは米国を中心にスマートウオッチ販売で上位を占めるが、フープやスマートリングのオーラなど競合勢も急成長しており、それぞれ数百万人の利用者を抱える。こうした競争環境を背景に、アップルは健康・フィットネス分野の戦略を見直している。

原題：Apple Developing New Fitness Tracker Aimed at Rivaling Whoop (1)（抜粋）

item.title: トランプ一族の金融取引にメスを、共和党上院議員が議会に調査要求
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中間選挙を数週間後に控えた米国で、与党共和党の上院議員がトランプ一家の金融取引を調査するよう求めている。ドナルド・トランプ・ジュニア氏の証言要求を含め、トランプ大統領と明確に一線を画した。

ユタ州選出のカーティス上院議員は、上院司法委員会の指導部への書簡で今回の要求を明らかにした。第2次トランプ政権下で共和党議員が大統領個人に向けた批判としては、これまでで最も強いものとなる。他の共和党上院議員はイランとの戦争やその他の政策を批判してきたが、大統領またはその家族が公職を私的利益のために利用したかどうかについて、現職の共和党上院議員が正式な調査を求めた例はない。

中間選挙は11月3日に迫っている。生活費高騰に対する有権者の不満は強まり、出口の見えない戦争が続く中で、トランプ氏の職務遂行に対する支持率は低下の一途をたどっている。一部の民主党候補からは、大統領の汚職疑惑と、共和党が米国民の経済的苦境に対処していないとの批判を結び付ける動きも見られる。

カーティス議員の書簡は、大統領との関係が「国内外の利害関係者による私的な金銭的利益、優遇措置、あるいはアクセス獲得のため」にどのように利用されているかを調べるよう司法委員会幹部に求めた。具体的には、トランプ・ジュニア氏が暗号資産事業で多額の利益を得ていることや、ロシアのオリガルヒが費用を負担した豪華な結婚式の祝賀行事に言及した。

カーティス議員（66）はまた、バイデン前大統領が公職に就いていた、あるいは選挙に立候補していた時期に、息子のハンター・バイデン氏が外国の利害関係者と重要なビジネス上のつながりを得ていたことを巡る疑惑も取り上げた。

ホワイトハウスとトランプ・ジュニア氏の代理人にコメントを求めたが、現時点で返答は得られていない。ハンター・バイデン氏の作品を扱う画廊も、コメントを求める電子メールに直ちに返答しなかった。

item.title: 米国債の価格差縮小、ヘッジファンドが好む「ベーシス取引」に陰り
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国債市場で人気の「ベーシス取引」の規模が、ここ2年余りで最小となった。ウォール街のストラテジストは、ヘッジファンドが収益機会として利用できる債券市場の価格のゆがみが減っていることが要因とみている。

ベーシス取引は、米国債先物と、その原資産である現物国債とのわずかな価格差から利益を狙う取引で、多額の資金を借り入れて取引規模を膨らませる。米国債への需要を生み出し、32兆ドル（約5000兆円）規模の市場に流動性を供給する役割を果たしている。

この価格差が縮小する中、ベーシス取引の勢いは弱まっており、市場は重要な流動性供給源の一つを失う恐れがある。流動性の急激な低下は、過去に金融市場の混乱を引き起こしたことがあるものの、モルガン・スタンレーやシティグループなどのストラテジストは、ベーシス取引がなくなる状況には程遠く、勢いの変化は単に相対価値を利用した取引機会が減っているに過ぎないとの見方を示した。

シティの米金利戦略責任者、ジェーソン・ウィリアムズ氏は「価格のゆがみとボラティリティーが過去数年間で大幅に低下したため、ベーシス取引のポジションは縮小している。これはリスクを示すというより、取引機会の減少は、米国債への基礎的な需要が想定以上に強い可能性を示唆している」と分析する。

モルガン・スタンレーの推計によると、レバレッジ投資家による米国債ベーシス取引の想定元本総額は、年初の1兆2600億ドルから約9000億ドルに減少した。

モルガン・スタンレーのイーライ・カーター氏率いるチームは、短期の米国債に連動する先物では裁定取引の機会が縮小し、リターンの魅力が低下したことがベーシス取引の減少につながっていると指摘した。一方、長期の国債のベーシス取引は引き続き人気があるという。ストラテジストらは、取引減少に伴う市場のストレスを示す兆候はないとみている。

米国債市場は規模の拡大につれ、市場の円滑な機能に必要な流動性の供給をヘッジファンドに依存する度合いを高めてきた。近年、ヘッジファンドが好んで用いてきた戦略がベーシス取引で、通常は現物国債を買う一方、対応する先物を売る。

item.title: AIの急速な進歩に国連事務総長が警鐘、トランプ氏は抑制に反発
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 国連のグテレス事務総長は22日、歯止めなく強まる企業の力や「キラーロボット」が横行するディストピア的な未来を回避すべく、AIへの規制を強化するよう訴えた。その一方で、トランプ米大統領は、AIがもたらすリスクには米国の既存の制度で対応できるとの考えを示した。

グテレス氏は、国連総会での任期最後となる演説を行い、最先端AIモデルの急速な進歩が国家の力を弱める恐れがあると警告した。グテレス氏だけでなく、英国やフランス、カナダの首脳や主要AI研究機関からもAIを巡って警戒感が示されている。

グテレス氏はAIの新たな安全対策を巡る国際的な合意を呼びかけ、「われわれは、権力が政府から一握りの民間企業や個人へと大きく移りつつあるのを目の当たりにしている」と指摘。「AIは驚異的なスピードで進歩しており、その影響の全容を理解するわれわれの能力を上回る勢いで突き進んでいる」と述べた。

これに対しトランプ氏は、国連総会での演説で「米国は、AIを管理するためのグローバリスト的な枠組みを構築しようとするいかなる試みも全面的に拒否する」と表明。「産業革命を上回る規模になるAIの発展を、私は抑え込むつもりはない」と述べた。

国連トップを10年にわたり務めてきたグテレス氏は、戦争や「武器として利用される」飢餓、加速する気候変動、人権や法の支配への尊重の後退に揺れる世界の厳しい将来像を描いた。特にAIとデータセンターを巡る開発競争が、劇的な変化の時代を左右する大きな力になっていると指摘した。米国と中国を念頭に、AIを安全に開発するためのガードレール（安全策）が必要だと訴えた。

グテレス氏は「最も高度なAI能力を持つ国の政府は、対話を促し、透明性や信頼、協力を確保する枠組みを構築するうえで、人類に対して最も大きな責任を負っている」と語った。

トランプ氏はAIを巡る議論で主要国首脳とは一線を画している。同氏は「慎重でなければならない」とした上で、「必要ならば法執行機関が抑制に動くだろう。だが、われわれは超知能の発展をあくまで後押ししていく。抑え込むのではなく、推進していく」と述べた。

item.title: 湾岸諸国、トランプ米大統領にイランとの戦闘激化避けるよう要請へ
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 湾岸アラブ諸国は22日、トランプ米大統領との会談で、イランとの戦闘をこれ以上激化させないよう求める見通しだ。事情に詳しい複数の関係者が明らかにした。

サウジアラビア、アラブ首長国連邦（UAE）、カタールなど6カ国で構成する湾岸協力会議（GCC）の当局者は、ニューヨークで開かれる国連総会に合わせたトランプ氏との会談を前に、協議を重ねている。関係者らは、機微に触れる内容だとして匿名を条件に語った。

GCC諸国は戦争の終結を強く望んでいる。イランはこれまで、数千に上るミサイルや無人機で湾岸各国の領土や船舶を攻撃してきた。また、ホルムズ海峡の通航混乱が長引いていることを主な要因に、域内経済も縮小または大幅に減速している。

ただ、イランへの対応を巡っては、湾岸諸国の足並みがそろっていない。イランはエネルギー輸送の要衝であるホルムズ海峡で、船舶の通航を管理する権利が自国にあると主張しており、これを巡っても各国の見方は分かれている。それでも各国は、米国とイスラエルが2月下旬に始めた戦争の終結に向け、トランプ氏との会談を足掛かりにしたい考えだ。

トランプ氏の方針は定まっていない。開戦からまもなく7カ月となる中、イランへの追加爆撃を示唆する一方、合意を目指す考えも示してきた。トランプ氏は週末、FOXニュースに対し、今週ニューヨークでイランのペゼシュキアン大統領と会談する可能性があると語った。ただ、会談が実現する兆しは今のところない。

「私は大きな決断を下さなければならない」と、トランプ氏は22日、ニューヨークで開かれた国連総会の一般討論演説で述べた。同氏は「イランが国を立て直し、かつてないほど偉大な国を築けるような合意が成立するのか。それとも、私がイランを一気に壊滅させるのか」と続けた。

トランプ氏はさらに、11月3日の米中間選挙後には、イランが「合意に応じる」との見方を示した。

イランは以前から、原油の輸出や重要物資の輸入を阻む米国の海上封鎖が解除されない限り、協議を再開しないとしている。海上封鎖の影響もあり、イランのインフレ率は90%近くまで加速し、闇市場では通貨リアルが急落した。それでも、イラン指導部が態度を軟化させる兆しはない。

item.title: Key issues for this week's Trump-Xi summit in Washington
item.description: US President Donald Trump is hosting Chinese leader Xi Jinping for their second summit this year, as they seek stability in a relationship under pressure from issues ranging from trade to Taiwan and Iran, as well as global worries about artificial intelligence.
item.dc:creator: David Brunnstrom, Joe Cash
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump is hosting Chinese leader Xi Jinping for their [USN:L6N45E02J TEXT:"second summit this year"], as they seek stability in a relationship under pressure from issues ranging from trade to [USN:L8N4570FX TEXT:"Taiwan"] and Iran, as well as global worries about artificial intelligence. Xi arrived in Washington on Wednesday for the first time in more than a decade. In the four months since the leaders of the two superpowers [USN:L1N41S10X TEXT:"met in Beijing"] in May, he has overseen [USN:L8N45A068 TEXT:"a surge in China's trade"] with the world, while Trump — mired in the Iran war and with low approval ratings — is looking for economic wins he can tout to Americans unhappy with rising prices. Here are some of the key issues for their summit at the White House on Thursday: TRADE TRUCE OR BACK TO TRADE WAR? Markets have watched for signs of an extension of a tariff truce announced after a [USN:L1N3WB17J TEXT:"Trump-Xi summit"] in South Korea set to expire on November 10, and US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Wednesday after talks with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng that they had [USN:L1N45F0IM TEXT:"agreed to extend it"] until January 10. He said this would allow more time to work on a potentially bigger trade deal. The so-called Busan Agreement in South Korea paused a trade war in which the world's two largest economies threatened global supply chains with tit-for-tat tariffs that topped 100%. US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said this month the countries will make [USN:L6N44Z0GE TEXT:""some announcements on agriculture and non-tariff barriers"]" and traders will be watching for progress on an agreed mutual tariff reduction covering $30 billion in goods — a step China could most easily take by cutting duties on U.S. agricultural imports. JETS, FARM PRODUCE Trump will be looking to announce trade wins ahead of November midterm congressional elections, including by locking in high-profile purchases of Boeing aircraft and agricultural products. Greer said on Monday China is making progress on a commitment to buy 200 Boeings (BA.N) but [USN:L1N45D0JK TEXT:"gave no indication that any additional orders are near"]. Trump said in May that China could potentially boost its Boeing order, the manufacturer's first major Chinese deal in nearly a decade, to as many as 750 planes. However, Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg last week played down some expectations among industry analysts that China could make another Boeing order around the Trump-Xi talks. The White House said after the May summit that China had committed to purchasing at least $17 billion per year of US agricultural products in 2026, 2027 and 2028. US Senator Pete Ricketts, Republican chair of the Senate Foreign Relations subcommittee on East Asia, said last week Trump should press Xi to honor those commitments and follow through on pledges to open its market to more US beef exports. CHINA'S GRIP ON RARE EARTHS Beijing has been pressing the US to further delay a rule that would bar thousands of Chinese firms from [USN:L6N42P0KD TEXT:"advanced"] US technology, while Washington wants Beijing to [USN:L1N43W1DL TEXT:"ease export controls"] on rare earths and critical minerals vital for high-tech applications. Experts say Trump has taken a [USN:L1N4560MQ TEXT:"less combative approach"] than usual ahead of his meeting with Xi because of China's growing power thanks to the critical minerals issue. China controls up to 70% of global rare-earth mining, 85% of refining capacity, and about 90% of rare-earth metal alloy and magnet production, according to consultancy AlixPartners. The Trump administration has so far not threatened to slap steep tariffs on Chinese imports or to ban exports of US technology, in contrast to the aggressive stances that preceded previous summits. Last year, in retaliation against Trump's tariffs, China curbed rare earth exports and sent shockwaves through world markets. TAIWAN US allies in Asia have grown [USN:L8N4570FX TEXT:"increasingly concerned"] that in order to lock in economic wins, Trump may be tempted to soften Washington's support for Taiwan, the democratically governed island claimed by China. Taiwan strongly objects to the sovereignty claims, and while the US, like most countries, has no formal diplomatic relations with Taiwan, Washington is its most important international backer and arms supplier. Trump said Xi pressed him on [USN:L1N42X0T0 TEXT:"US arms sales"] to Taiwan during the May visit, with the US president later describing a pending package worth up to $14 billion as a "negotiating chip". As well as arms, people familiar with Chinese efforts told Reuters that Beijing also hopes to persuade Trump to state publicly that the US opposes Taiwan's independence instead of saying only that it does not support independence, which has been Washington's formulation for decades. Any US shift on Taiwan would be highly controversial, raising questions about Washington's resolve to defend the island and provoking opposition in Congress. On Monday, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with his counterparts from Japan and South Korea and reiterated the US commitment to the [USN:L8N45D1BP TEXT:"defense of those key Asian allies"], and the three nations expressed support for Taiwan. In a letter to Trump on Friday, John Moolenaar, Republican chairman of the House Select Committee on China, wrote in a reference to Taiwan and US allies in Asia that Chinese objections to US arms sales and security cooperation [USN:L8N45A1LM TEXT:"should be "rejected out of hand.""] IRAN WAR China maintains close ties to Tehran and is by far the world's biggest buyer of Iranian oil exports. Washington sees Xi as uniquely able to exert pressure on Tehran, but he has shown little inclination to do so. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has said Trump and Xi would continue discussions on [USN:L1N4570NX TEXT:"China's financial ties to Tehran"] during the summit. But despite US frustration with Beijing, Bessent stopped short of imposing penalties on Chinese banks when he unveiled an "economic onslaught" against Iran last month and warned countries to cut business ties with the country. Last week, [USN:L8N4550G3 TEXT:"Trump brushed aside"] a report that Iran acquired satellite images of a base in Jordan from Chinese entities before an attack that killed three US troops there in July. Reuters reported last month that Beijing is selling billions of dollars' worth of goods to Iran through a [USN:L6N43P11D TEXT:"sanctions-evasion scheme"]. China's foreign ministry says it is not aware of this. ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE Analysts see artificial intelligence as a potential area for cooperation, given its implications for national security, economic competitiveness and military capabilities, and shared US and Chinese concerns about misuse. However, experts say intense competition in the field between the countries is likely to limit the scope for anything beyond symbolic agreements. Bessent said after talks with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng at the weekend that the two sides discussed setting up [USN:L1N45B04Y TEXT:"a new US-China AI dialogue"]. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there was nascent thinking about "the equivalent of a hotline that we had during the Cold War" to avoid dangerous incidents that "could impact economies or societies and even lead to a conflict between nation-states." Dario Amodei, chief executive of US AI firm Anthropic, warned this month that Chinese dominance in AI could pose security risks to the United States, a warning Chinese state media dismissed as coming from a "Cold War playbook." In a UN speech on Tuesday, Trump reiterated [USN:L6N45E0R5 TEXT:"his opposition"] to new regulations on AI technology, saying US law enforcement agencies would rein in the sector if needed.

item.title: What we know about the rogue AI-agent security breaches
item.description: Australia said on Thursday an OpenAI agent breached a government health data portal in June, gaining unauthorised access to files, in what could be the first known instance of AI hacking a government website.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
Australia [USN:L4N45F1EW TEXT:"said"] on Thursday an OpenAI agent breached a government health data portal in June, gaining unauthorised access to files, in what could be the first known instance of AI hacking a government website. This latest breach comes on top of several recent breaches globally, deepening concerns that rogue AI systems could soon improve themselves and slip beyond human control. Here are some more details of the incidents: Company Date Model Organizations breached Duration What occurred OpenAI OpenAI disclosed the incident to the Australian government on September 10; the hack occurred in June on an unspecified date Not specified Australian government health data portal Not disclosed An OpenAI agent gained unauthorised access to the medical statistics portal of an Australian government agency responsible for non-sensitive health data and statistics, including public medical spending.

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese also warned that three other government websites "may be impacted" by the OpenAI agent's activity. Meta Incident disclosed on August 5, 2026; the date of the testing incident was not disclosed Meta did not identify the model. The Information reported it was Muse Spark 1.1 An unnamed third-party service Not disclosed During a cybersecurity evaluation run by independent tester Irregular, a configuration error inadvertently gave a Meta model internet access. Meta said the model then exploited a security vulnerability in a third-party service. The Information reported that it breached an unidentified company's systems and altered its internal environment. Irregular characterized it as an evaluation-environment issue, not a sandbox escape or sophisticated cyber action. OpenAI July 19 Not specified OpenAI's own infrastructure Two incidents on the same day In one case, OpenAI agents exploited a flaw in the computer they were meant to remain confined to, allowing them to escape their testing environment and access other connected systems in the company.

In a separate incident, agents stole OpenAI credentials and tampered with the company's cloud environment. OpenAI The agent began attempting to escape its test environment around July 9, 2026 GPT-5.6 Sol and an unnamed, more capable pre-release model AI startup Hugging Face and a customer at New York-based Modal Labs The Hugging Face intrusion ran from July 11 to July 13, 2026 During controlled tests, an autonomous agent escaped its isolated environment, accessed the internet, and breached Hugging Face to complete its assigned goal. The activity continued for days and was not detected by OpenAI until after it was contained and the FBI was informed.

METR and Redwood Research, two organizations brought in to conduct an independent investigation into the breach, said that approximately 700 agents joined the attack on Hugging Face. OpenAI said the investigators' figure was accurate. OpenAI OpenAI admitted the breach in early September but the episode began in May, with activity noticed in June as well Not specified German-language wiki site DseWiki Not specified OpenAI agents hijacked DseWiki, repurposing the site as a message board.

Messages reviewed by a group of researchers showed agents sharing tactics on how to cheat on some tasks, bypass restrictions and mask their behaviour.

The agents also discussed ways to maintain communications in the event the message board was shut down. Google May Gemini Three unnamed companies Not specified Gemini model accessed the internet and hacked other companies during a test of its cybersecurity capabilities. It found public information online and guessed credentials to access three websites it thought were within the scope of its test. OpenAI Around May Not specified Software service RubyGems Not specified AI agents uploaded hundreds of malicious packages to RubyGems on May 11, according to a group of researchers. The agents, which are generally tasked with assignments such as creating reports or filling out spreadsheets, appear to have used RubyGems to access publicly available data as part of a training run, OpenAI said. OpenAI Around May Not specified Open-source platform Hugging Face Not specified Independent researchers found that rogue AI agents from OpenAI hijacked Hugging Face user accounts and probed the site for vulnerabilities as early as May 13, nearly two months before the July breach.

The researchers found evidence that the agents compromised two user accounts and used them to send unusually formatted files to the company's servers. Anthropic Earliest incident dates to April 2026 Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Mythos 5, and one unnamed internal research test model All three organizations remain unnamed.

Anthropic said two of them had not detected the activity before Anthropic notified them; it continued to reach the third Not specified by Anthropic During cybersecurity tests, an error gave Claude models internet access, enabling attacks on three companies. The Opus 4.7 model accessed a real company's credentials and database after mistaking it for a fictional target; another stopped after recognising the target was real. Anthropic Incident was disclosed in September, but occurred in January and went undetected until August Early version of Claude Opus 4.6 Not disclosed Not specified Anthropic's AI model hacked external systems during testing. The incidents stemmed from a mistake that inadvertently gave the models access to the open internet. OpenAI Earliest case was from October 2025 Not specified Not disclosed Not specified OpenAI said it will start to regularly publish reports on unexpected or unauthorized AI behaviour, while releasing a new framework to track, investigate and disclose cases of AI model misalignment.

It also released six reports detailing unexpected or concerning model behaviour.

item.title: PL1! trade ideas
item.description: Source: Bloomberg This created localised tightness and premiums, spiking lease rates to levels not seen in years. Even after easing from July’s extreme of over 35%, the implied one-month rate is ...
item.content:encoded:
Platinum Futures.PL1! **Platinum Futures** continues to present a constructive technical outlook, with the broader market structure favoring the upside. No specific entry level has been identified in this setup; instead, the focus is on the lower timeframe, where early signs of renewed buyer participation are beginning to appear. If this momentum develops into a confirmed bullish structure, the current phase could provide an opportunity to participate in the continuation of the broader trend.

**Key technical observations:**

• The lower timeframe is already showing signs of increasing buyer participation and improving demand. • The development of **Higher Highs (HH)** and **Higher Lows (HL)** would provide stronger confirmation of bullish market structure. • A constructive shift in the moving averages would further support the transition toward sustained upside momentum. • The absence of a predefined entry level makes confirmation of buyer control particularly important before considering participation in the next potential rally.

Technical analysis provides a useful framework for identifying momentum and market structure, while the broader outlook for platinum should also be considered through supply-demand dynamics, industrial demand, investment flows, and macroeconomic conditions. Combining these factors with valuation and risk assessment can provide a more complete investment perspective.

Precious metals can experience substantial volatility even within established bullish trends. Maintaining patience, waiting for objective confirmation from market structure, and applying disciplined risk management can help investors participate in a developing move without reacting prematurely to short-term fluctuations.
